_source: Booster_config.tsv — economy fields (code/lvUnlock/free/price/maxAds) added from the sheet; id/order kept stable since sim.ts and boosterCharges index into this array positionally.

boosters.name: Shift-up Row
boosters.description: Rotate every queue column up one instance; the displaced front item(s) refill from the bottom of their own column.

boosters.name: Ingredient Pick
boosters.description: Reveal more rows and pick any one slot, not just the front row — including a combined or linked instance.

boosters.name: Clean Table
boosters.description: Clear dirty stacks from the grid. numCleanStack = -1 clears all of them.

boosters.name: Auto Complete Dish
boosters.description: Finish one dish of the left-most customer, drawing from the backpack first, then the grid, then the queues.

boosters.name: Refill Customer Time
boosters.description: Refill the wait time of every active customer back to full.

boosters.name: More Grid Slot
boosters.description: Add one more column to the grid.

saveMeVariants.name: SaveMe - Out Of Slot
saveMeVariants.description: Save Me when the grid is full — sweep everything into a backpack (raws auto-cook), placed in the top-right slot; the backpack is checked before the grid when matching.

saveMeVariants.name: SaveMe - Out Of Time
saveMeVariants.description: Save Me when a customer runs out of patience — refill their wait time back to 100%.
